events.label: Kick-off
events.decision: Are the scope, team and calendar confirmed for the engagement?
agenda: Present the objective, the two phases and the 26-week plan
Align on scope and the 200-shipper pilot success measure
Confirm the team and the steering meeting calendar

events.label: Workshop 1: first findings
events.purpose: Review first evidence and the prototype
events.decision: Which hypotheses should the blueprint and pilot plan detail?
agenda: Present the hypotheses and the shipper and market evidence
Review the wireframe prototype of the shipper journey
Discuss which hypotheses to detail in the blueprint

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.purpose: Decide on the blueprint and pilot launch
events.decision: Is the blueprint approved and the pilot cleared to launch?
agenda: Present the blueprint with tested hypotheses
Review the pilot plan with milestones and launch criteria
Decide whether the blueprint is approved and the pilot cleared

events.label: Workshop 2: pilot readiness
events.decision: Are the pilot KPIs, hire list and first shipper group ready for go-live?
agenda: Present the pilot KPIs agreed with key stakeholders
Review the first shipper group and the list of key internal hires
Confirm readiness against the launch criteria of the pilot plan

events.label: Workshop 3: first-wave data
events.purpose: Review first-wave data and plan next steps
events.decision: Confirm the first-wave findings as input to the scale-up business case?
agenda: Review the first platform version with its launch record
Present first-wave usage data and shipper feedback
Discuss what the findings imply for the scale-up business case

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Decide on the pilot results and scale-up
events.decision: Does the steering group accept the pilot results and the scale-up plan?
agenda: Present pilot results against the 200-shipper target
Review the scale-up business case, implementation plan and roadmap
Decide whether to accept the pilot results and the scale-up plan
